title: Eternal Valparaíso
overview: A place where people doesn't let their soul or history be robbed, where everyday is vital, as it could be the last. Sergio Olivares, still a political prisoner after thirteen years, and Antonio Cruz, an exiled chilean returning to his hometown after 28 years, find themselves in the magical realness of the south. They don't see themselves as victims, but as men who have made a decision.
